bankruptcy.evaluation_reason: Bankruptcy.csv is the unlabeled competition test feature matrix (byte-identical to lupitaastari/bankruptcy 'bankruptcy_Test_X.csv'). Its companion labeled train file covers a different row set (55/5000 content-identical rows), so no genuine labels exist for these 5000 rows. PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/precision/recall/F1 would require fabricated labels and are therefore not computed.

cross_dataset.consistency_answer: the frozen Isolation Forest + rule baseline pipeline executes deterministically on both datasets; outcome evaluation is impossible without labels, so no generalization claim beyond pipeline portability is supported
cross_dataset.dimension_notes: bankruptcy Attr columns are anonymized ratios with no balance-sheet semantics, so no Risk Engine metric is computable; financial-statements supports a partial subset (see risk_mapping.json)
cross_dataset.label_gated_metrics: unavailable for both datasets (documented in evaluation.json per dataset)
